title: 镜春园 Jingchun Yuan
subtitle: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden · outside the walls · confidence B, assumed

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 60 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a neighbouring imperial or princely garden outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: crown property: 寿安固伦公主 (holder from 1841) died in the intercalary 3rd month of 1860 and it reverted to the 内务府 (S1215); 'destroyed 1860' (S1205); decayed after 1860, merged into 鸣鹤园 1896 (S1215)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: C: on today's 镜春园路 (osm way 595764208), north-east end of 未名湖; its extent, a circle of 90 m, is assumed

facts.label: Note
facts.value: PKU's 1802 grant to 庄静公主 (S1205) is rejected by 何瑜 (S1215): chain 奕纯, 禧恩 / 裕恩, 绵愉 1828, 寿安固伦公主 1841.

sources.text: 北京大学政策法规研究室, 文物保护: 镜春园 Jingchun Garden (with 淑春园, 鸣鹤园)
何瑜, 《清代皇家赐园与北大校园》, 故宫博物院院刊 2021 no.2; reprinted on 澎湃 2021-03-16 as 清代皇家赐园与北大里的鸣鹤园、朗润园等十园
